environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.19. The billing-prod namespace has a PeerAuthentication resource setting mTLS to STRICT. An AuthorizationPolicy named 'billing-internal-only' is applied to the billing-prod namespace with spec.action ALLOW, spec.rules[0].from[0].source.namespaces=['billing-prod'] and spec.rules[0].from[0].source.principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/billing-prod/sa/*'. A second AuthorizationPolicy with action DENY and empty spec (catch-all deny) is applied at mesh level in istio-system namespace. The combination means only workloads with SPIFFE identities from billing-prod namespace can reach the invoice service. However, X-Tenant-Id header validation is still not performed in application code - the control relies solely on the assumption that all billing-prod workloads serve a single tenant partition.
